episode.episode_title: The $350 Billion Question: SK Hyper's Massive Data Centre Ambition
episode.episode_description: SK Hyper is eyeing a colossal $350 billion investment for South Korean data centre capacity. We look at the scale, the strategy, and why the company is keeping its chequebook firmly in its pocket for now.
episode.selection_reason: The lead verified story from today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.

selected_story.headline: SK Hyper eyes $350B for massive South Korean data centre buildout
selected_story.source_title: SK Telecom unit SK Hyper is in talks with tech firms and investors to finance 15GW of data center capacity in South Korea by 2035; the first 5GW will cost $350B (Bloomberg)

short.title: SK Hyper eyes $350B for massive South Korean data centre buildout
short.description:
The scale of this investment highlights the immense capital requirements for AI infrastructure, though the company plans to pace spending based on actual tenant demand rather than committing the full amount upfront.
